card.name: Inside long drug and brand names
card.fires_on: Partway through a long, rare drug or brand name, on a middle piece such as 'it' in ombitasvir/paritaprevir or 'lit' in pioglitazone. Also fires inside a few rare proper names.

card.writes: It mostly promotes odd word pieces from other languages, so the output effect is not clear.
